title: UCC § 2-205 — firm offers
summary: The casebook introduces enforceability of certain merchant assurances that an offer will remain open without consideration.
notes: The chapter asks the reader to consult the provision for all conditions and the maximum period. It discusses merchant status and compares New York’s broader signed-writing statute.
